description: V0.5b integration smoke test: the LLM agent with bounded memory, action guidance and targeted prompts (agents/llm, llm-agent 2, live, one local model) beside the no-op baseline on the bundled sustainable scenario, one fresh development seed, 14 days, daily decisions. It shows that the agent takes part in a complete, replayable session with its memory carried across decision points; it is not a performance benchmark and not a model comparison. Run from the repository root with DREAMTEAM_LLM_BASE_URL set.
seedPlan: Chosen 2026-10-27, before any run on it and without reference to earlier results: 40701, the next unused block after V0.4a's 40401-40405, V0.4b's 40501-40505 and V0.5a's 40601. It appears nowhere else in the repository. Not a reference seed (1001-1020), not a V0.2 development seed (901-910), not drawn from any reserved stream; the sealed holdout guard accepts it.

external.description: the LLM agent (agents/llm/llm_agent.py, llm-agent 2, prompt llm-agent-prompt/v2, memory llm-agent-memory/v1), live, with the model and limits of docs/benchmark/v05b-dev/llm-settings.json; bounded memory within the run, an operations and a staffing batch at most per decision point
